description: This line plot illustrates the growth in vocabulary size over the course of 500 iterations for three languages—Spanish, Japanese, and an unlabeled orange line—within the DIY-MKG polyglot language learning system. The x-axis represents the “Number of Iterations,” ranging from 0 to 500 on a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 100. The y-axis represents “Vocabulary Size,” ranging from 0 to 5000 on a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 1000. The blue line, labeled “Spanish,” starts at a vocabulary size of 0 at iteration 0 and increases linearly to a vocabulary size of approximately 4700 at iteration 500. The green line, labeled “Japanese,” also starts at 0 at iteration 0 and increases linearly to approximately 3700 at iteration 500. The orange line, unlabeled in the legend, begins at 0 and rises to approximately 3000 at iteration 500. All three lines show a consistent upward trend without any dips or plateaus, indicating steady vocabulary growth across iterations.
